paragraphs.text: That is, be liberal to the poor, and though it seems to be as a thing ventured on the sea, yet it will bring you profit.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: As the clouds that are full pour out rain, so the rich that have abundance must distribute it liberally.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: He exhorts to be liberal while we live: for after, there is no power.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He who fears inconveniences when need requires will never do his duty.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: Be not weary of well doing.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: That is, which of your works are most agreeable to God.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: That is, of affliction and trouble.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: He derides them who set their desire in worldly pleasures as though God would not call count.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Meaning, carnal lusts to which youth is given.
paragraphs.label: k
paragraphs.anchor: put away evil from thy flesh
